answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one ivory weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 214 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 87 times the capital for one share. The wander report publishes the merge explicitly at each karst. A farm of 1739 identities would post 4981 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
